DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車教室についてのご質問ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a question about the bicycle class, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもが参加したいと言っています。自分の自転車を持って行くのか、教室で使う物を借りるのか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 教室へ子の自転車持参か貸与か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: My child says they want to participate. I would like to know whether to bring their own bicycle or borrow one used in the class.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask the class organizer whether to bring your child's bicycle or whether one is provided. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この教室は、ご自身の自転車をお持ちいただく案内です。こちらの持ち物欄をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: For this class, the instructions ask participants to bring their own bicycles. Please look at this list of things to bring.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。子どもの自転車を持って行きます。ヘルメットも、この欄にありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自車持参とヘルメット案内欄を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I will bring my child's bicycle. A helmet is listed here too, isn't it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that participants bring their own bicycles and that the list mentions a helmet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。保護者の付き添いもお願いします。保護者用の自転車は持ち物に入っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. We also ask a parent or guardian to accompany them. A bicycle for the parent or guardian is not on the list.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 親も一緒に自転車で練習すると思っていました。私は付き添いとして、歩いて見守る準備でよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 保護者は自転車練習でなく付き添いか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I thought parents would also practice riding together. Should I prepare to accompany my child and watch over them on foot?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether the parent accompanies the child rather than practicing cycling. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 保護者は、当日の担当が案内する場所で付き添ってください。練習の説明はお子さんへ行います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Parents should accompany their children at the location indicated by the staff on the day. The practice instructions will be given to the children.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、子どもにも、自分で説明を聞く教室だと伝えます。私の自転車まで車へ積む必要はなさそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 子本人が説明を聞くと伝え親自転車運搬不要と理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will also tell my child that this is a class where they listen to the instructions themselves. It seems I won't need to load my own bicycle into the car too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will tell the child to listen to the instructions themselves and that you understand you need not transport the parent's bicycle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ほかに、ご案内で確認したい所はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Is there anything else in the information that you would like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受付の開始時刻を見たいです。午前九時ですね。持ち物の紙を持ち帰り、子どもと前の日にそろえます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 架空受付九時を確認し前日に親子で持物準備すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I would like to check when registration starts. It is nine in the morning, isn't it? I will take the list home and get everything ready with my child the day before.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the fictional registration time of nine o'clock and say that parent and child will prepare the items the previous day. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、こちらの案内をお使いください。ご参加をお待ちしております。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please take this information sheet. We look forward to your participation. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日は、お手紙の差出しでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you mailing a letter today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: いいえ。まだ手紙は書いていません。家で用意するため、封筒だけ二枚買いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 手紙未作成で空封筒二枚だけ購入したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: No. I haven't written the letters yet. I would like to buy just two envelopes so I can prepare them at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you have not written the letters and want to buy only two empty envelopes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらに白い封筒と、花の絵がある封筒がございます。どちらをご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We have white envelopes and envelopes with flower illustrations here. Which would you like?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一枚は会社への連絡用なので白い方にします。もう一枚は友人用で、花の絵の方を選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 会社用白と友人用花柄を一枚ずつ選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: One is for correspondence with my company, so I will choose white. The other is for a friend, and I would like the one with flowers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose one white envelope for the company and one floral envelope for a friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一枚ずつですね。白い方は五十円、花の絵の方は八十円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: One of each, then. The white one is fifty yen, and the floral one is eighty yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 合わせて百三十円ですね。その二枚をお願いします。友人用の絵がある方は、住所を書く所も見せてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 架空単価五十円八十円の計百三十円を確認し柄封筒宛名欄を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: That is one hundred and thirty yen altogether, right? I'll take those two. Could you also show me where to write the address on the illustrated one for my friend?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the fictional prices of fifty and eighty yen, totaling one hundred and thirty yen, and ask about the address area on the patterned envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 裏返すと、ここに宛名を書く空きがあります。絵は反対側です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you turn it over, there is space here for the recipient's address. The illustration is on the other side.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 書く所が分かりました。今日は宛名もまだ書かず、家で会社と友人の住所を見てから用意します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 宛名空間を確認し家で二宛先を見て書くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I see where to write now. I won't write the addresses today either; I will prepare them at home after checking my company's and friend's addresses.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the address space and say you will write at home after checking both destinations. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 百三十円をお預かりします。封筒は曲がらないよう袋へお入れします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll take one hundred and thirty yen. I will put the envelopes in a bag so they do not bend.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。二枚とも未使用のまま受け取りました。帰宅したら、それぞれに合う便箋で手紙を書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未使用封筒二枚を受取り各便箋へ家で手紙を書くと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I have received both envelopes unused. When I get home, I will write the letters on stationery suited to each.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you received two unused envelopes and will write the letters at home on the respective stationery. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、この二枚をお持ちください。お便りの準備にお役立てください。ご来局ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take these two envelopes, then. I hope they help with preparing your letters. Thank you for visiting our post office.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご希望の変更について、教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me what change you would like.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家賃を毎月二十五日に送る設定があります。今月だけ二十日に送りたいので、どう相談するか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 毎月二十五日家賃設定を今月のみ二十日にしたいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a setting to send my rent on the twenty-fifth of every month. I want to send it on the twentieth for this month only, and would like to know how to discuss that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about changing the monthly rent setting from the twenty-fifth to the twentieth for this month only. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 変更したい月と、現在の設定が分かるものをお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me something that identifies the month you want to change and your current setting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この控えです。今月が対象で、金額と受取人はそのままです。来月からは二十五日に戻したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 既設定控えを示し金額受取人不変で来月元日付希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here is my copy. This is for the current month; the amount and recipient remain the same. I want to return to the twenty-fifth from next month.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the record of the existing setting and say the amount and recipient stay unchanged and you want the original date again next month. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今月の指定日だけを変えるご希望として確認します。今月分は、ほかの方法でもう送りましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will confirm that you wish to change only the scheduled date for this month. Have you already sent this month's payment another way?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだです。二十日に自分で送ってから相談するつもりでしたが、先に現在の設定を見ていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今月別振込未済で先に現設定確認を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. I was going to send it myself on the twentieth and then ask, but I would like you to check the current setting first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have not made another transfer this month and want the current setting checked first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が現在の状態と、変更できる方法を確認します。二十日へ変更したい理由もお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff member in charge will check the current status and how it can be changed. Please also tell us why you want to change it to the twentieth.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今月は二十一日から旅行します。旅行中に控えを探すより、出発前に手続きを確認しておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二十一日旅行出発前に手続確認したい理由を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I am going on a trip from the twenty-first this month. Rather than looking for the record while traveling, I want to confirm the procedure before departure.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to confirm the procedure before leaving on a trip on the twenty-first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのご希望をお伝えします。控えへ、対象月と二十日の希望も記してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will pass on your request. Please also write the relevant month and your requested date, the twentieth, on the copy.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 書けました。今月二十日、来月から二十五日で、同じ金額と受取人です。これで担当へ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 対象月希望日翌月以降日付を控えへ記し担当相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've written it. The twentieth this month and the twenty-fifth from next month, with the same amount and recipient. I will use this to consult the staff member in charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you wrote the relevant month, requested date, and dates from next month on the copy and will consult the staff member. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当へおつなぎします。ご旅行の準備が進みますように。ご来店ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will connect you with the staff member in charge. I hope your travel preparations go smoothly. Thank you for visiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お買物のメモで、何かお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for something on your shopping list?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 「香菜」と書いてあります。家族はパクチーと言っていましたが、同じ物か分かりません。売り場で見せてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 香菜メモと家族のパクチー呼称が同一か実物確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says “Chinese parsley.” My family called it cilantro, but I don't know whether they are the same thing. Could you show me the actual product in the store?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to see the product to confirm whether the Chinese parsley on the list is the same as what your family calls cilantro. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: パクチーは香菜とも呼ばれます。こちらが、その商品です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Cilantro is also called Chinese parsley. This is the product.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この緑の葉ですね。写真だけだと、ほかの葉野菜と間違えそうだったので、名前を聞けてよかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 商品葉を見て他葉野菜との誤認懸念を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: These green leaves, then. I thought I might confuse them with another leafy vegetable from a photo alone, so I'm glad I could ask the name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Look at the leaves and explain your concern about confusing them with another leafy vegetable. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 使う量は、お決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Have you decided how much you will use?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: スープの上へ少し載せます。毎日使う予定ではないので、小さい袋を一つ見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: スープへ少量で日常使用予定なしの小袋を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will put a little on top of soup. I don't plan to use it every day, so I would like to see one small bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request a small bag because you will use only a little on soup and do not plan to use it daily. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらが小さい袋です。大きい束より、量を見てお選びいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here is a small bag. You can look at the quantity and choose it instead of a large bunch.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この袋にします。家族が苦手かもしれないので、鍋全体へ最初から入れず、自分の器へ少し載せたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 小袋を選び家族苦手の可能性から自器に少し載せると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll take this bag. My family might dislike it, so I want to put a little in my own bowl instead of adding it to the whole pot at the start.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the small bag and say you will put a little in your own bowl because your family might dislike it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ほかに、お探しの材料はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Are there any other ingredients you are looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日はこれだけです。買物メモへ「香菜、パクチー」と並べて書いたので、家族にも同じ商品名で話せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 両名をメモし家族へ同商品として伝えられると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: That's all today. I wrote “Chinese parsley, cilantro” side by side on my list, so I can talk with my family using names for the same product.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you noted both names and can tell your family they refer to the same product. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、こちらの一袋をどうぞ。お料理をお楽しみください。ご利用ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is your bag, then. Enjoy your cooking. Thank you for shopping with us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お子さんの縄跳びを、ご覧になっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you watching your child skip rope?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。回数を数えてと言われましたが、咳が出るので大きい声で数えられません。見て分かる方法を考えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 咳で声を出せず子縄跳び回数の視覚伝達法を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. They asked me to count, but I have a cough and cannot count loudly. I would like to think of a way they can see the count.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about visually communicating the child's skipping count because coughing prevents you from speaking aloud. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 一回跳ぶごとに指を一本ずつ出して、五回で止める方法もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: You could put up one more finger for each jump and stop at five.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: その方法を子どもへ伝えます。私が五本出したら一度止めて、紙へ印を付けることにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 五指で停止し紙へ印を付ける方法を子へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will explain that method to my child. When I hold up five fingers, we will stop once and make a mark on paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Tell the child about stopping at five fingers and making a mark on paper. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お子さんにも、止める合図が分かったか聞いてみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please ask your child whether they understand the signal to stop too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 五本で止まると分かったそうです。手を振る合図ではなく、指の数を見てもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 手振りでなく指本数を見る停止合図を子が理解したと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: They say they understand to stop at five fingers. I will have them look at the number of fingers, rather than a waving gesture.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the child understood that the stop signal is the number of fingers rather than a wave. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まず、短い回数で試してみますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Would you like to try a small number first?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。今五回できました。子どもも指を見て止まれたので、一回分の丸を紙へ書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 五回試行で止まれ紙へ一回丸を記す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. They just managed five jumps. My child was able to look at my fingers and stop, so I will draw one circle on the paper for that round.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the child stopped after a trial of five jumps and you will mark one round with a circle on paper. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 続けるかは、お二人でお決めください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please decide together whether to continue.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: もう一回だけ試したいと言っています。二回目が終わったら休みます。声を出さずに数えられて助かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: あと一回試して休む予定と無発声計数の効果を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: They say they want to try just one more round. We will rest after the second round. It helped to be able to count without speaking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you plan to try one more round and rest, and explain that counting without speaking helped. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、無理なくお楽しみください。お帰りもお気をつけて。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then enjoy yourselves without overdoing it. Take care on your way home. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ロッカーの場所をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for the lockers?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 荷物を入れた所へ戻りましたが、どの扉だったか忘れました。鍵の札を見て教えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ロッカー位置を忘れ鍵札で案内を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I came back to where I put my belongings, but forgot which door it was. Could you look at the key tag and tell me?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you forgot the locker location and ask for directions using the key tag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 札は四十七番ですね。この並びの奥にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The tag says forty-seven. It is toward the back of this row.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 四十七ですね。手前に四番が見えて、それを私の番号かと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 番号四十七と四番との見違いを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Forty-seven, right. I saw number four near the front and thought that might be my number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the number is forty-seven and explain that you mistook it for number four. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二桁の番号です。四十七番は、奥の上から二段目です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: It is a two-digit number. Number forty-seven is toward the back, in the second tier from the top.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。大きい扉を探していましたが、私の荷物は小さいかばん一つなので、小さい扉ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 奥二段目の小扉と自己荷物を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I understand. I was looking for a large door, but my belongings are just one small bag, so it is a small door, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the small door in the second tier toward the back and your own belongings. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、その番号の小さい扉です。鍵もお手元にありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, the small door with that number. You have your key with you too, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: あります。鍵と札を離さず持って、四十七番へ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 鍵と札を一緒に持ち該当扉へ行くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I do. I will keep the key and tag together and go to number forty-seven.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will keep the key and tag together and go to the correct door. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 荷物を出した後は、ロッカーの中もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: After taking out your belongings, please check inside the locker too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 小さいかばんと、その横に入れた傘を取り出します。扉の中が空になったら、友人の所へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: かばん傘取出しと内部確認後友人へ戻ると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take out my small bag and the umbrella I placed beside it. Once the locker is empty, I will return to my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will remove the bag and umbrella, check inside, and then return to your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、こちらの奥へどうぞ。お忘れ物なく、よい旅を。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please go toward the back here. Don't leave anything behind, and have a good trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 名前札を、上着の襟に付けられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Can you attach the name tag to the collar of your jacket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この上着は部屋で脱ぎます。付けたままだと名前が見えなくなるので、別の付け方はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 上着を脱ぐため襟クリップ以外の名札方式を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I will take this jacket off in the room. If I leave the tag on it, my name won't be visible. Is there another way to wear it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a name tag option other than a collar clip because you will remove your jacket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 首に掛ける紐式もあります。そちらへ替えましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We also have one on a neck strap. Shall I exchange it for that?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。中の服には襟がないので、紐式の方が使いやすそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 襟のない内服なので紐式への交換を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, please. The clothes underneath have no collar, so the neck strap seems easier to use.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request a change to a neck strap because your clothes underneath have no collar. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらをお使いください。中の名前の紙は、そのまま移せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please use this one. You can transfer the same paper with your name on it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 名前の紙を入れ替えました。文字が表になる向きで掛けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 名前紙を移し表向きで掛けたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have transferred the name paper. I will wear it with the writing facing forward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you moved the name paper and put the tag on facing forward. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 講座が終わったら、札のケースと紐を受付へお返しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: When the course ends, please return the tag holder and strap to reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。名前の紙だけは自分で持ち帰るのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 講座後の返却対象と名前紙持帰を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. Should I take just the name paper home myself?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm what to return after the course and whether you take the name paper home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 紙はお持ち帰りいただけます。ケースから取り出して、ケースと紐を返してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: You may take the paper home. Remove it from the holder and return the holder and strap.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、終わったら紙を抜いて返します。今は上着を脱いでも名前が見えるので、この札で教室へ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 終了後紙を抜きケース紐返却と教室移動を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will remove the paper and return them when it ends. My name is visible even if I take off my jacket now, so I will go to the classroom with this tag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will remove the paper and return the holder and strap afterward, and will now go to the classroom. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、講座をお楽しみください。受付でお待ちしております。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then enjoy the course. We will be waiting at reception. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 二十八番の方はいらっしゃいますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 父が二十八番です。待っているうちに眠りました。今起こすので、少し待っていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 父が二十八番で眠っており起こす時間を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My father is number twenty-eight. He fell asleep while waiting. I will wake him now, so could you wait a moment?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say your father is number twenty-eight and is asleep, and ask for time to wake him. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お父様のお名前も、確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please let me confirm your father's name too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 山田宏です。番号の紙は父のかばんにあります。この紙をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 父の氏名と番号紙を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: His name is Hiroshi Yamada. The number slip is in his bag. Please look at this slip.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give your father's full name and show the number slip. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お名前と番号が合っています。お父様が目を覚まされたら、ご一緒にどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: The name and number match. Once your father wakes up, please come together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 声をかけました。父も今の呼び出しが自分だと分かりました。上着を着る時間をいただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 父が目覚め呼出を理解し上着着用の時間を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have spoken to him. My father now understands that the call was for him. I would like some time for him to put on his jacket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say your father woke up and understood the call, and ask for time for him to put on his jacket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらでお待ちします。お荷物はおそろいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will wait here. Do you have all your belongings?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 父のかばんと上着、私のかばんがあります。飲み終わった空のボトルも、袋へ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 親子のかばん上着と空ボトルを片付けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: We have my father's bag and jacket, and my bag. I will also put the empty bottle we finished drinking from into the bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will gather the parent's and child's bags and jacket and put away the empty bottle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご準備できましたら、この通路をお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: When you are ready, please go down this passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そろいました。父と一緒に向かいます。少し待ってくださってありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 準備完了と父と進むことと待機への感謝を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: We have everything. I will go with my father. Thank you for waiting a little.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you are ready and will go with your father, and thank them for waiting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、ご案内します。足元にお気をつけて。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will show you the way. Please watch your step. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 最後に自転車を置いた時刻を伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Could you tell me when you last parked the bicycle?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: その話の途中ですが、家族から電話が来ました。探してもらっているので、短く出てもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族探索中の着信に短く出る許可を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: We are in the middle of discussing that, but my family is calling. They are helping look for it, so may I answer briefly?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask permission to briefly answer a call from your family who are looking for the bicycle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どうぞ。お話が済みましたら続けましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Of course. We will continue when you finish your call.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。家族が見つけたのは予備の鍵でした。自転車そのものは、まだ見つかっていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族の発見は予備鍵だけで自転車未発見と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. What my family found was the spare key. The bicycle itself still hasn't been found.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say your family found only the spare key and the bicycle remains missing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 鍵は、今お持ちの物とは別ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: That key is separate from the one you have with you now, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。私の手元の鍵は一本で、家には同じ鍵の予備があるそうです。今は家族の電話を終えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自己鍵一本と家の予備鍵を説明し電話終了を知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I have one key with me, and apparently there is a spare of the same key at home. I have finished the call with my family now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain you have one key and there is a spare at home, and say the call has ended. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、置いた時刻のお話へ戻りましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then let's return to when you parked it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 昨日の午後五時ごろです。帰りに歩いて帰ったので、今朝取りに行くまで見に戻っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 前日五時駐輪と徒歩帰宅後未確認を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It was around five yesterday afternoon. I walked home afterward, so I did not go back to look until I went to collect it this morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you parked at five yesterday and did not check again after walking home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今朝は、何時ごろ確認しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Around what time did you check this morning?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 八時ごろです。昨日五時に置き、今朝八時に見当たらなかったという順番です。今はこの続きを説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今朝八時の未発見と前日駐輪の順序を整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Around eight. The sequence is that I parked it at five yesterday, and it was missing at eight this morning. I will now explain what happened next.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Set out the sequence of parking yesterday and finding it missing at eight this morning. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その経過から伺います。それでは、もう少しお話しください。ご相談ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will ask about that sequence of events. Please tell me a little more. Thank you for coming to consult us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの切手シートを、お買い求めでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to buy this sheet of stamps?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 絵を見ていました。送りたい手紙は一通だけなので、この切手を一枚だけ買えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 手紙一通用に展示切手一枚の購入可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was looking at the pictures. I only have one letter to send, so can I buy just one of these stamps?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can buy one displayed stamp for a single letter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは一枚ずつも販売しています。封筒はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We sell these individually too. Do you have an envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この封筒です。必要な料金を確かめてから、一枚を選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 封筒を示し料金確認後に切手を選びたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here is the envelope. I would like to check the required postage before choosing one stamp.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the envelope and say you want to choose a stamp after checking the postage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 封筒を確認しました。この切手一枚で、この手紙の料金に合います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I have checked the envelope. One of these stamps covers the postage for this letter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、この絵の一枚をお願いします。シート全体を買う注文ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 選んだ絵一枚だけでシート購入ではないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I would like one with this picture, please. I am not ordering the whole sheet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want only one stamp with the chosen picture and are not buying the sheet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 一枚をご用意しました。切手は今お貼りになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: I have one ready for you. Would you like to affix it now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。封筒のここを空けてあります。この一枚を貼って差し出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受取切手を空けた所へ貼り差し出すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I left this spot on the envelope clear. I will affix this one stamp and mail it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will affix the stamp you received to the space left clear and mail the letter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 貼れましたら、封筒をこちらへどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once it is affixed, please hand me the envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 貼れました。残りのシートはそのままで、この一枚の代金だけ払います。封筒もお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 貼付後一枚代金の支払と封筒受渡しを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: It is on now. Leave the rest of the sheet as it is; I will pay only for this one stamp. I will hand you the envelope too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm you have affixed it, will pay for one stamp, and will hand over the envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お手紙をお預かりします。ご購入ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22216-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will take your letter. Thank you for your purchase. Take care on your way home.
